description: Retrieves current advisory consultation availability, lead times, and scheduling channels for Pretoria, Johannesburg, Cape Town, and global remote engagements. When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'check_consultation_slots' on TWVS Advisory & Consulting (twvs.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'list_practice_areas' or 'get_partner_ecosystem' or 'submit_consultation_inquiry' for their respective operations). Parameters: division (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.
name: check_consultation_slots
title: Check Consultation Slots
